project_title: 景德镇：千年窑火，一瓷一世界（2×15s 双段一镜到底版）
category: 城市文旅宣传片 · 2×15s 长镜头无缝版
creative_concept: 专为 Google Flow 15s 生成机制定制：将 30 秒大片浓缩为【上篇 15s：泥火成器（匠心拉坯→青花晕染→千度窑变）】与【下篇 15s：器成天下（瑶里烟雨→青花梅瓶→御窑夜色）】两大 15 秒一镜到底长镜头。两段 15s 视频之间在 00:15 处通过【金色窑火散景光斑（Golden Bokeh）→ 江面晨曦波光对焦】实现天衣无缝的跨片段桥接。

visual_bible.camera_and_lens: ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 Anamorphic Lens (35mm & 85mm Macro continuous zoom)
visual_bible.lighting_and_color: Warm amber kiln firelight (3200K) contrasting with Song Dynasty Qingbai jade-cyan shadows (6500K), Kodak Vision3 500T color science
visual_bible.texture_and_atmosphere: Subtle 35mm organic film grain, floating clay dust motes in volumetric Tyndall light beams, tactile wet clay and crystalline ceramic glaze reflections
visual_bible.style_suffix_en: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, continuous fluid gimbal movement.

product_dna.subject_lock_en: museum-grade Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain vase (Qinghua Meiping), translucent ivory-white jade-like glaze, cobalt-blue hand-painted swirling cloud motifs, delicate golden ice-crackle glaze network
product_dna.materials_and_reflections: 半透明玉质感白釉底、深邃苏麻离青钴蓝晕染、高光处有细腻的冰裂纹玻璃态镜面反光
product_dna.ingredients_strategy: 两段 15s 均可直接使用【T2V 纯文生】一镜到底生成。若在 Google Flow 中使用 SceneBuilder Extend（前 8s + 后 7s 延展），每个镜头下方同时提供了『15s 完整直出 Prompt』与『8s+7s Extend 拆分版』；若希望第 2 段中的青花梅瓶绝对严丝合缝，可将下方提供的梅瓶定妆图放入第 2 段 Ingredients。

audio_guide.bgm_style: 第1段（0-15s）：空灵古琴泛音配合湿润陶土旋转ASMR，第8秒窑火燃起时加入低沉大提琴独奏与火焰轰鸣；第2段（15-30s）：清脆瓷器冰裂开片声切入，恢弘东方交响乐与现代电子低频共振推向高潮，尾声以一声清越的瓷鸣余音定格。
audio_guide.bgm_prompt_en: 30-second cinematic oriental luxury commercial soundtrack, first 15 seconds feature intimate tactile clay ASMR, ethereal Guqin harmonics, and building emotional cello with roaring fire; at 15 seconds a crystalline porcelain chime triggers an epic modern orchestral strings and deep sub-bass climax, ending at 30 seconds with a pure resonant porcelain ring, Wong Kar-wai meets Apple commercial score, 92 BPM.

shots.phase_name: 上篇：泥火成器 · 从指尖拉坯到千度窑变
shots.gen_mode_badge: T2V 纯文生 · 15s 一镜到底
shots.gen_mode_reason: 第一段 15s 聚焦『泥、笔、火』微观流体与光影演变，采用一镜到底连续推轨运镜（Continuous Macro Push & Orbit），纯文生即可发挥 Veo 极致的物理材质与火焰光效。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 【0-5s】暗室暖光下匠人双手旋转拉坯水珠飞溅 → 【5-10s】镜头推进衔接狼毫画笔在素坯上晕染钴蓝青花 → 【10-15s】烈焰包围瓷坯熔融出晶莹釉面，结尾化作满屏金色失焦光斑。
shots.visual_detail_zh:
15秒连续长镜头（Single continuous 15s take）：
• [00:00-00:05] 极近景俯拍，一束琥珀色丁达尔逆光刺破青色暗室，匠人苍劲的双手在高速旋转的拉坯机上塑出湿润的高岭土圆碗，细密水珠慢动作飞溅；
• [00:05-00:10] 摄影机顺时针平滑下移并贴近素坯外壁，一支狼毫画笔蘸满深邃苏麻离青钴蓝料水落于素坯之上，蓝色水墨纹路在白色陶土肌理中自然晕染蔓延；
• [00:10-00:15] 镜头环绕推进，四周骤然燃起赤金色的千年柴窑烈焰，1300度高温下哑光素坯表面熔融化作晶莹剔透的液态玻璃白釉；第14至15秒镜头大光圈完全失焦（Rack focus out），漫天金色火星化作满屏温暖梦幻的圆形散景光斑（Golden Bokeh Orbs）。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 15s 一镜到底：俯拍旋转推入（0-5s）→ 顺滑下移贴外壁微距横移跟拍画笔（5-10s）→ 环绕推入火焰中心并大光圈虚化失焦收尾（10-15s）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 开篇首镜：黑场中一声清脆水滴声，琥珀色侧逆光骤然点亮旋转的泥坯中心。
shots.transition_type: LIGHT_BOKEH (15s 中点光斑失焦无缝桥接)
shots.transition_to_next_zh: 第 15 秒末尾：火焰与火星完全虚化为满屏晃动的温暖金色圆形光斑（Golden Bokeh）；与第 2 段 15s 开头的『清晨江面金色波光光斑由虚变实对焦』形成 100% 视觉同构接力。
shots.flow_video_prompt_en:
[15s Continuous One-Take Prompt]
A continuous, unbroken 15-second cinematic macro camera journey through the birth of Jingdezhen porcelain. From 0 to 5 seconds, an overhead close-up captures weathered artisan hands shaping wet spinning white clay on a potter's wheel as shimmering water droplets fly in slow motion. From 5 to 10 seconds, the camera smoothly spirals down to a macro side-profile as a fine calligraphy brush strokes deep cobalt-blue pigment onto the spinning clay, the blue ink blooming organically across the surface. From 10 to 15 seconds, roaring golden kiln flames erupt around the vessel, melting the matte clay into a glowing, translucent liquid-glass porcelain glaze; in the final second, the lens racks completely out of focus, dissolving the golden fire and floating embers into fullscreen creamy circular golden bokeh light orbs. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, continuous fluid gimbal movement.

Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, 8k.
• Extend (+7s to 15s Prompt): Camera continues tracking around the painted porcelain vessel as roaring golden wood-kiln flames ignite around it, melting the surface into a shimmering translucent glass glaze, then the lens racks completely out of focus into fullscreen glowing golden bokeh light orbs.
shots.voiceover_zh: 一捧高岭土，落笔藏山河；千度烈焰里，淬炼不灭的温润。
shots.sfx_zh: 0-5s 湿润陶土旋转与水滴声 → 5-10s 狼毫触碰素坯沙沙声 → 10-15s 柴窑烈火低频轰鸣与松木爆裂声
shots.sfx_prompt_en: Wet clay spinning on potter wheel and water splashes transitioning into brush stroke on clay, then swelling into roaring kiln fire and crackling embers

shots.phase_name: 下篇：器成天下 · 从烟雨古镇到千年瓷都盛景
shots.gen_mode_badge: T2V 纯文生 / 可选 Ingredients 垫图 · 15s 一镜到底
shots.gen_mode_reason: 第二段 15s 聚焦『境、器、城』宏大空间转换，利用光斑对焦入画 + 廊桥木柱甩镜遮罩 + 仰拍穿出御窑红砖穹顶航拍，一气呵成完成城市文旅升华。
shots.visual_summary_zh: 【15-20s】金色光斑对焦为瑶里古镇烟雨江面与竹筏 → 【20-25s】镜头掠过古建木柱无缝切入展厅环绕传世青花梅瓶 → 【25-30s】顺瓶口向上穿出御窑博物馆红砖拱顶，蓝调夜色航拍落版。
shots.visual_detail_zh:
15秒连续长镜头（Single continuous 15s take）：
• [00:15-00:20] 画面从满屏温暖的金色散景光斑（无缝承接上篇结尾的火光光斑）平滑对焦（Rack focus in），化作清晨阳光洒在景德镇瑶里古镇碧绿河面上的粼粼波光，青色晨雾笼罩着黛瓦白墙与一叶竹筏；
• [00:20-00:25] 摄影机向右平滑擦过一根深色廊桥木柱作为前景自然遮罩（Foreground wipe transition），走出阴影时已置身于光影静谧的御窑展厅，镜头环绕一尊温润如玉的明代青花云龙纹梅瓶，琥珀色追光掠过细腻的金色冰裂纹釉面；
• [00:25-00:30] 镜头顺着梅瓶浑圆的瓶口向上仰拍升起，直接向上穿出景德镇御窑博物馆标志性的红砖双曲拱顶建筑，无缝转为宏大的蓝调时刻（Blue Hour）无人机航拍向后拉升，温暖的红砖窑拱灯光对称倒映在镜面水池中，中央夜空留白定格『中国·景德镇』。
shots.camera_movement_zh: 15s 一镜到底：散景光斑由虚变实对焦江面（15-20s）→ 向右擦过深色立柱前景遮罩进入环绕梅瓶特写（20-25s）→ 向上仰拍升起穿出红砖拱顶转为大航拍后拉全景（25-30s）
shots.entry_bridge_zh: 承接上篇 15s 结尾的满屏金色散景光斑：从完全相同的圆形金色光斑（Golden Bokeh）平滑对焦切入。

shots.flow_video_prompt_en:
[15s Continuous One-Take Prompt]
A continuous, unbroken 15-second cinematic camera journey from ancient misty river to monumental porcelain architecture. From 0 to 5 seconds, the shot starts completely out of focus with fullscreen glowing golden bokeh orbs, smoothly racking focus into sunlight shimmering on a jade-green river in misty Yaoli ancient town with white-walled heritage houses. From 5 to 10 seconds, the camera glides right, passing closely behind a dark wooden pillar that wipes the frame and reveals a museum-grade Ming-style blue-and-white porcelain Meiping vase glowing under an amber spotlight with delicate ice-crackle glaze texture. From 10 to 15 seconds, the camera cranes upward above the circular vase rim, rising seamlessly out of the iconic curved red-brick kiln arches of the Jingdezhen Imperial Kiln Museum into a sweeping twilight blue-hour aerial pull-back shot, with warm amber arch lights reflecting symmetrically in tranquil mirror pools below. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber kiln rim lighting contrasting with deep jade-cyan shadows, volumetric atmospheric mist, cinematic commercial color grading, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic, 8k, continuous fluid gimbal movement.

Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo 70 anamorphic lens, Kodak Vision3 500T 35mm film grain, warm amber lighting with deep jade-cyan shadows, 8k.
• Extend (+7s to 30s Prompt): Camera cranes upward from the blue-and-white porcelain vase, rising seamlessly above the curved red-brick kiln vaults of the Jingdezhen Imperial Kiln Museum and pulling back into a grand twilight blue-hour aerial wide shot with warm amber lights reflecting symmetrically in mirror water pools.
shots.voiceover_zh: 天青色等烟雨，一器成而天下知。千年窑火，生生不息——中国·景德镇。
